# The Harness Lab

> The Harness Lab (https://theharnesslab.com/) is a software company. Spencer Teague, a self-taught software engineer in San Angelo, Texas, finds industries still doing expensive work by hand and builds products that automate it. Mineral title is the first product line. Title-Desk, Artificial Landman, and AI Landman are live today. Every customer of a product uses the same software, paid per run or by subscription. The Harness Lab LLC owns the code and IP.

White Carrara marble with gold circuit wires marks the company site (`theharnesslab.com`). Black marble marks the engineering foundry (`theharnesslab.dev`), where state machines, verification benches, and commit-level provenance are published.

## Products

- [Title-Desk](https://title-desk.com/): Landman title research software. Upload or request county records. It reads the documents, builds the chain of title and runsheet, resolves mineral ownership and computes net mineral acres. The hosted web app is paid per run.
- [Title-Desk Agent](https://desktop.title-desk.com/): The Title-Desk desktop app, sold by subscription. The same software as Title-Desk.
- [AI Landman](https://ailandman.io/): Hosted landman title product on the same platform.
- [Artificial Landman](https://artificiallandman.io/): Hosted Texas mineral title examination for land teams, brokerages and operators.
- [BrandStreams](https://brandstream.my/): Earlier product. Multi-model social publishing software evolved from MyAIMediaMgr.
- [APEX.BUILD](https://apex-build.dev/): Earlier product. Multi-AI cloud development platform.
